pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ A cụt (đầu nhọn như mỏ hạc), dầm ngang trên, cao 101,6 m
pylons_en: 2 truncated-A pylons with pointed tips and an upper cross-beam, 101.6 m

pylon_custom.description: Two legs lean inward from the deck edges (A-like) but do not meet: a cross-beam joins them at ≈85% height and each leg continues above it as a pointed tip ('crane beak'). Fan stays in two planes anchored just below and at the beam.

model3d.notes: Shape from the single Commons deck-level photo. Was modelled as inverted-Y; the legs never merge.

review: Modelled as inverted-Y; the legs actually stay apart with a top beam and pointed tips
Truncated A with beam ≈60 m above deck and pointed tips
